newsitem.title: USA: Apple unveils Color OneScanner for Net.
newsitem.headline: Apple unveils Color OneScanner for Net.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc on Thursday unveiled a new scanner that includes technology to place graphics documents on the Internet.
The Apple Color OneScanner 1200/30 includes optical character recognition technology that converts documents to hypertext markup language (HTML), the language of the Net.
The scanner is available immediately in the United States and will ship overseas by October 1.
The scanner has 600 x 1200 optical resolution and 4800 x 4800 interpolated resolution for small areas. It provides 30-bit depth color, which recognizes over one billion colors.

Color OneScanner ships with Apple's Dispatcher 2.0, new software that provides a guide to functions such as scanning, image editing, optical character recognition, printing, faxing, copying, and archiving/retrieval.
Apple said it estimates the retail price for the Color OneScanner will range from $799 to $849; certain accessories will be priced separately.
